description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520001 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Homagama area. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
